title: A tale of perfect fit and phantom optima: how data-driven models can fail in real-time optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.23885v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-time optimization (RTO) relies on process models to locate economically optimal operating conditions. Because developing first-principles models requires significant process knowledge, data-driven alternatives are increasingly attractive. Modern machine-learning models can fit historical plant data accurately and often pass standard validation tests. Whether such models can be trusted for economic optimization, however, remains unclear. We investigate this question using a vinyl acetate monomer benchmark process with a unique, well-conditioned economic optimum. We train a structured hybrid model that combines known mass balances and thermodynamics with a neural-network closure for unknown kinetics, and a fully data-driven neural ordinary differential equation (ODE) model. translated_title: 完美拟合与幻影最优：数据驱动模型如何在实时优化中失效的故事
translated_abstract: 实时优化（RTO）依赖于过程模型来定位经济上最优的操作条件。由于开发第一性原理模型需要大量的过程知识，数据驱动的替代方案越来越具有吸引力。现代机器学习模型能够准确拟合历史工厂数据，并且通常能通过标准验证测试。然而，这些模型是否能够被信任用于经济优化，仍不清楚。我们使用一个具有独特、条件良好的经济最优的醋酸乙烯单体基准过程来研究这一问题。我们训练了一个结构化混合模型，该模型结合了已知的质量平衡和热力学与神经网络闭合项来描述未知动力学，以及一个完全数据驱动的神经普通微分方程（ODE）模型。这两个模型都能准确重现工厂测量结果，并且在随机初始化下预测差异很小。然而，它们的经济最优却存在显著差异。
tldr: 该论文揭示了数据驱动模型即使在拟合和验证上表现完美，也可能在实时经济优化中产生幻影最优，导致优化结果不可靠。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that data-driven models, even with perfect fitting and validation, can yield phantom optima in real-time economic optimization, leading to unreliable results.
